comment: Rate dependence of the tests at 44.1, 96 and 192 kHz, see scripts/check_sr.py (triage of 2026-10-29). `symbols`: functions tied to the rate by a parameter in samples or a coefficient, their tests measured but not judged. `accepted`: other tests, by key; a reason starting with 'fault:' is a defect of the library to fix, 'not explained yet:' a deviation still to understand.

symbols.an.goertzel: `n`: the Goertzel block size, in samples
symbols.an.goertzelComp: `n`: the Goertzel block size, in samples
symbols.an.goertzelOpt: `n`: the Goertzel block size, in samples
symbols.ba.line: `n`: number of samples to reach the new target received at its input
symbols.ba.period: `p`: period as a number of samples
symbols.ba.pulse: `p`: period as a number of samples
symbols.ba.pulsen: `n`: pulse length as a number of samples
symbols.ba.slidingMax: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingMean: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingMeanp: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingMin: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingRMS: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingRMSp: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingReduce: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingSum: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.slidingSump: `n`: the number of values to process
symbols.ba.spulse: `n`: pulse length as a number of samples
symbols.de.multiTapSincDelay: `tau1`: initial delay in samples (can be fractional)
symbols.ef.reverseDelayRamped: `delay`: echo delay in samples, an integer power of 2 known at compile time
symbols.ef.reverseEchoN: `delay`: echo delay in samples, an integer power of 2 known at compile time
symbols.ef.tapeStop: `crossfade`: A crossfade in samples to apply when resuming normal playback. Crossfade is not applied during the enabling of the tape-stop.
symbols.fi.adaptFIR: `step`: adaptation step, as a signal evaluated at every sample
symbols.fi.allpass1_noclip: `c`: coefficient of the first-order allpass (target, may change at any time)
symbols.fi.apnl: `a1`: allpass coefficient used while the filter state is positive (-1 < a1 < 1)
symbols.fi.fb_comb: `del`: current integer comb-filter delay (the feedback loop length), between 1 and maxdel (a non-integer value is truncated)
symbols.fi.fb_fcomb: `del`: current (float) comb-filter delay (the feedback loop length), between 1 and maxdel
symbols.fi.fbcombfilter: `del`: current comb-filter delay between 0 and maxdel: an integer for `fbcombfilter` (uses `de.delay`; a non-integer value is truncated), a float for `ffbcombfilter` (uses `de.fdelay`); the loop length is `del+1`
symbols.fi.ff_comb: `intdel`: current (integer) comb-filter delay between 0 and maxdel (a non-integer value is truncated)
symbols.fi.ff_fcomb: `del`: current (float) comb-filter delay between 0 and maxdel
symbols.fi.ffcombfilter: `del`: current integer comb-filter delay between 0 and maxdel (a non-integer value is truncated, as in `ff_comb`)
symbols.fi.integrator: sums its input at every sample (`pole(1)`)
symbols.fi.lms: `mu`: the adaptation step, applied at every sample
symbols.fi.nlf2: `r`: loss factor per sample (set to 1 to make a sinusoidal oscillator): the amplitude decays by sqrt(r) per sample, a time constant of -2/(ma.SR*log(r)) seconds, so the decay depends on the sample rate (for a time constant t: r = exp(-2/(t*ma.SR)))
symbols.fi.pospass: built around SR/4: its lowpass has its cutoff at SR/4 - fc
symbols.fi.pospass6e: `fc`: the -3 dB point lies below it and depends on the sample rate (doc)
symbols.fi.rev1: `N`: current feedback comb-filter delay in samples (the loop length, an integer)
symbols.fi.wgr: `r`: loss factor per sample (set to 1 to make a numerically stable oscillator): the amplitude decays by sqrt(r) per sample, a time constant of -2/(ma.SR*log(r)) seconds, so the decay depends on the sample rate (for a time constant t: r = exp(-2/(t*ma.SR)))
symbols.fi.zero: `z`: location of zero along real axis in z-plane
symbols.ma.BS: the current block size, a number of samples
symbols.mi.nlBow: mass-interaction: the friction acts per simulation step of one sample
symbols.mi.oscil: mass-interaction: mass, stiffness and damping per simulation step of one sample
symbols.no.markov_step: `trig`: a nonzero sample moves the chain one step
symbols.no.pink_filter: fixed IIR coefficients (`fi.iir`): the frequencies of the filter scale with the rate
symbols.no.pink_noise_vm: latches clocked by the bits of `ba.time`: its octaves are counted in samples
symbols.os.tphase: `p`: the step added at every sample to a counter of `N` steps per cycle
symbols.pf.flanger_mono: `curdel`: current dynamic delay in samples, between 1 and dmax (values below 1 act as 1)
symbols.pf.flanger_stereo: `curdel1`: current dynamic delay in samples for the left channel, between 1 and dmax
symbols.pt.pinkTrombone: each waveguide section of the tract is one tick long, so its acoustic length and every formant scale with the tick rate (pinktrombone.lib, 'Sample rate'; the original has the same property)
symbols.pt.pinkTrombone2: each waveguide section of the tract is one tick long, so its acoustic length and every formant scale with the tick rate (pinktrombone.lib, 'Sample rate'; the original has the same property)
symbols.pt.ticksPerSample: each waveguide section of the tract is one tick long, so its acoustic length and every formant scale with the tick rate (pinktrombone.lib, 'Sample rate'; the original has the same property)
symbols.pt.tract: each waveguide section of the tract is one tick long, so its acoustic length and every formant scale with the tick rate (pinktrombone.lib, 'Sample rate'; the original has the same property)
symbols.pt.tract2: each waveguide section of the tract is one tick long, so its acoustic length and every formant scale with the tick rate (pinktrombone.lib, 'Sample rate'; the original has the same property)
symbols.pt.tractExt: each waveguide section of the tract is one tick long, so its acoustic length and every formant scale with the tick rate (pinktrombone.lib, 'Sample rate'; the original has the same property)
symbols.re.dattorro_rev: `pre_delay`: pre-delay in samples (fixed at compile time)
symbols.re.fdnrev0: `delays`: N delay lines, N a power of 2, lengths (in samples, at least 2) preferably coprime
symbols.re.jcrev: delay lengths fixed in samples (`fi.rev1`, `fi.rev2` of 347, 113, 37, 1601, ... samples)
symbols.re.mono_freeverb: `fb1`: coefficient of the lowpass comb filters (0-1)
symbols.re.satrev: delay lengths fixed in samples (`fi.rev1`, `fi.rev2` of 778, 901, 1011, ... samples)
symbols.re.stereo_freeverb: `fb1`: coefficient of the lowpass comb filters (0-1)
symbols.rm.sumn: `n`: the block size in samples, an int > 0 known at compile time
symbols.si.smooth: `s`: the pole of the one-pole lowpass, a coefficient applied at every sample
